scripts.allure:open: python3 -m http.server 8080 --directory allure-report & sleep 2 && google-chrome http://localhost:8080
scripts.allure:report: npm run allure:generate && npm run allure:open
scripts.cluster:delete:openreportOnBrowser: npx playwright test tests/ui/clusterDeletion.spec.ts --project=chromium; npm run allure:report
scripts.cluster:delete:openreportOnBrowser:UI: npx playwright test tests/ui/clusterDeletion.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed; npm run allure:report
scripts.cluster:delete:report: rm -rf allure-results allure-report; npx playwright test tests/ui/clusterDeletion.spec.ts --project=chromium; npm run allure:report
scripts.cluster:dashboard:parallel:report: rm -rf allure-results allure-report; npx playwright test tests/ui/clusterDashboard.spec.ts --project=chromium --headed --workers=2; npm run allure:report
scripts.full:headed:report: npx playwright test --project=chromium --headed; npm run allure:report
